Rule-10 flag: discovery machines compliant top-2|Q_t<=2K_HYPO selection, BUT greedy pooling of all uncertain untested-on-ancestry hypotheses produced structurally infeasible node compositions. N0006 (H0009+H0011+H0012): H0009 needs content-conditioned channel gate while H0011 prescribes the SAME gate driven by a frozen random input (mutually exclusive inputs on one component). N0007 (H0013+H0010+H0011+H0012): parent N0001 has NO channel gate, so H0011 (sever the gate's input) is unimplementable without re-encoding H0009's gate. Consequence: each new champion child accumulates 3-4 mechanisms (incl. wounded H0009 0.320, H0010 0.400), diluting per-hypothesis attribution. Proposing minimal selection adjustment to user before touching dynamics.

RULE-10 APPROVED (user 'A'): composition-feasibility filter + adjoin cap. New src/cac/expt/mechanisms.py registry maps each hypothesis to the head components + config switches it consumes; conflicts() rejects co-composing hyps that share a component or switch (H0009 vs H0011 both on channel_gate -> mutually exclusive inputs; H0003 vs H0007 both select backbone_readout). select_hypo() gains mandated=[...] param: explicit bookings (--new or --book) are forced into Q_t; when mandated present, adjoins capped at ONE compatible hypothesis; final feasible() pass also de-conflicts the paper's own autonomous selection. Deviates from paper Eq.5-6 sample-path ONLY at composition time (scoring untouched). Verified: discovery hypo N0001_champion --book H0012 -> ['H0012','H0010'] clean; tests 15/15; CONFORMANCE OK.

MAJOR: runner never passed cfg.augment or cfg.seed to FSC147DataModule. All runs under the new harness (seeded champion 21.459 baseline, N0003/N0004/N0005/N0006/N0007) trained with augmentation OFF while the historic pre-migration engine trained with augment=true (old train.py line 189) -- likely explains a large part of the 19.647 vs 21.459 gap. Also the train shuffle/augmentation RNG stream was unpinned: datamodule seed=None, so loader order depended on how many RNG draws model construction consumed (construction-order dependent). Fixed: runner now wires augment, seed, num_workers into the real datamodule and seed into the smoke datamodule; AGENTS.md rule 13 adds append-only construction order (new component built after all parent modules) so shared-module init draws stay paired; dropout is 0 so training consumes no other RNG. Same-seed replicate of canonical champion (same config 679f37c, same runner): 23.3126 @ep28 vs canonical 23.2932 @ep26 (delta 0.0194). Verdict: the new harness is deterministic to ~0.02 MAE (residual from nondeterministic CUDA atomics in bilinear-upsample backward, not covered by cudnn flags). The v1-vs-canonical 1.8 MAE level shift is therefore NOT day-to-day noise; awaiting seed+1 run to decide whether it is systematic to the canon harness mode or seed-20260830 bad luck.

seed=20260831 under canon harness (noaug,EMA,seeded,deterministic): best 21.3126 @ep32 vs seed=20260830 23.293. Spread ~+-1 MAE across seeds: the v1-vs-canon level gap is SEED LUCK, not a systematic harness penalty. Scientific consequence: absolute single-seed numbers carry ~1 MAE irreducible level noise, so 0.30 bars mean nothing across seeds -- BUT all lab comparisons are SAME-SEED (20260830), deterministic (0.02 repro), shared-module inits (rule 13 append-last), shared data order (v2 wiring): the CONTRASTS are precise paired tests, so contradicts verdicts stand as within-protocol contrasts. The baseline LEVEL 23.293 is one draw; child results are paired draws against it. Mission target should be quoted as a level+spread once more seeds exist.
